selection.reason: R148 is the consolidated approval regulation for position, stop and reversing lamps, all of which this rear lamp integrates.
The integrated PMMA prism retro-reflector must be approved as a retro-reflector, typically Class IA, under the consolidated retro-reflective devices regulation.
R48 governs the mounting position, geometric visibility, colour, number and electrical connection of rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors on the M1 vehicle.
The LED modules on a PCB, with their associated driver electronics, are an electrical/electronic sub-assembly and must meet emission and immunity requirements.
The rear lamp forms part of the M1 vehicle's external surface, so its lens and housing projections and edges must meet the external projection requirements.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the lamp uses replaceable standardised LED light sources rather than the stated non-replaceable LED modules, those light sources must be R128 approved.
